sweet: Hey, I have been meaning to say hi for a while. How is your week going?
You came to mind today, so I thought I would say hello properly.
Hi. No clever line, I just wanted to talk to you.
funny: I had a whole opening line prepared, then I forgot it. So: hi.
Quick survey: are you the type who replies fast or the type who makes people wait?
Hi. My friends said not to send this. I do not always listen.
bold: I saw your photo and stopped scrolling. What are you up to today?
You seem like the most interesting person on my phone right now. Prove me right.
I am not going to pretend this is random. I wanted to talk to you.
sheng: Niaje, uko aje? Nimekuwa nikifikiria kukucheck.
Sasa. Uko free leo ama ni hustle tu?
Mambo. Nimeona nikuje nikuulize uko aje.

sweet: Tell me the small things about your day, I actually want to hear them.
That sounds like it took a lot out of you. How are you holding up now?
I like how you explain things. Go on.
funny: Wait, finish that story before I lose it laughing.
So what you are telling me is you survived all that and still made it sound funny.
I have decided you are the entertainment for the rest of my evening. Continue.
bold: I want to hear the part you left out.
You are easy to talk to, which is a problem for my sleep.
Keep going, I am enjoying this more than I planned to.
sheng: Wacha uongo, endelea kudrop hizo story.
Unaweza kuwa mtu wa kufurahisha aki. Endelea.
Kwani hiyo ndio ilikuwa yote? Nipee full story.

sweet: Hey, no pressure at all. Just checking you are doing okay.
I realised we left the conversation in the middle. Where were we?
Sending a small hello in case your week has been heavy.
funny: Breaking news: a WhatsApp chat has gone quiet. Experts are baffled.
I am reopening this case. Where did we stop?
You disappeared like a government promise. Anyway, hi.
bold: You went quiet. I noticed, and I am here anyway.
Rounding back because I liked where we were going.
I do not do the waiting game well, so: what are you doing this week?
sheng: Ulienda wapi? Umepotea aki.
Niaje, bado uko? Nilidhani umenipotezea.
Sasa, tuliacha wapi? Rudia hapa.

sweet: I would love to see you properly. Coffee this week, if you are free?
There is a place I think you would like. Should we go on Saturday?
I enjoy talking to you here. I would like to try talking to you in person.
funny: My chat game is strong, but I am told I am better with a coffee in hand. Test me?
Proposal: one hour, one cafe, no phones on the table. If it is terrible, we both go home early.
You have earned a promotion from texting to real life. When are you free?
bold: I am asking you out. Saturday afternoon, I pick the place.
Let us stop pretending this is only texting. When are you free?
Free on Saturday? I have a place in mind and I am not taking no quietly.
sheng: Tuchill kesho? Nakuchagulia place poa.
Uko free Saturday? Tuonane tustory kwa macho.
Wacha tuongee hapa tu, tukunywe chai Saturday.

sweet: You have a way of making an ordinary conversation feel like the best part of my day.
I noticed you listen properly. That is rare.
The way you carry yourself is quietly impressive.
funny: You are dangerously easy to like. This is a formal complaint.
I was going to be cool about this, but you are genuinely funny. Congratulations.
You have ruined normal conversation for me. Nobody else keeps up.
bold: You are the best thing to happen to my notifications.
I like your mind, and I am not going to be shy about it.
You look good, but it is the way you think that keeps me here.
sheng: Wewe ni poa aki, hata siwezi kuficha.
Uko na style ya kipekee, na inafurahisha.
Si ati naongea tu, wewe ni wa maana aki.

sweet: I got that wrong and I am sorry. I would rather fix it than be right.
That came out badly. I did not mean it the way it landed.
I have thought about what you said, and you had a point.
funny: I have reviewed the footage and I was clearly at fault. Apologies.
That was not my finest moment, and I am officially withdrawing it.
I am prepared to admit I was wrong. Please note the date, this is rare.
bold: I was wrong. I am not going to dress it up.
I overstepped. Tell me what would make it right.
No excuses from me. I am sorry, and I will do better.
sheng: Nimekosea, na ninaomba msamaha aki.
Sikupaswa kusema hivyo, samahani.
Nilikosea, na nimekuja kusema pole.

sweet: You are trouble, and I am choosing not to notice.
Careful, I might actually enjoy arguing with you.
Fine, you win this one. Do not get used to it.
funny: I am screenshotting this for the day you deny it.
You talk a lot for someone with that profile picture.
Your confidence is inspiring, considering the evidence.
bold: Say that again, but this time to my face.
You are all talk until Saturday.
I let you win because I like you. Do not tell anyone.
sheng: Wewe ni mkorogoto aki, lakini naelewa.
Acha kujifanya, wewe si poa hivo.
Utaongea sana lakini mwisho utakubali.

sweet: Tell me more about {word}, I like how you talk about it.
You mentioned {word} earlier and it stayed with me. How did that go?
funny: {word}? That is the most you thing you have said all day.
I read {word} and immediately had three follow up questions.
Explaining {word} to me like I am your student, go ahead.
bold: You mentioned {word}. I want the whole story, not the summary.
Keep going about {word}. I am listening properly.
About {word}. Tell me the version you do not tell everyone.
sheng: Hiyo {word} ndio gani sasa? Nieleze.
{word} imenishika aki. Endelea.
Wacha kudrop {word} halafu unyamaze.
